summary.text: Laura Jackson is the Democratic candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 85, in the November 3, 2026 general election; she advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Kim Dailey in a race with no incumbent. Ballotpedia lists her as the Democratic nominee for the same district in 2018, 2020 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Laura Jackson was the Democratic candidate for Montana House of Representatives District 85 in 2018, when she lost to incumbent Republican Theresa Manzella, 69.8 percent to 30.2 percent, and in 2020, when she lost to Michele Binkley, 74.5 percent to 25.5 percent.
In 2024 she advanced unopposed from the Democratic primary and lost the general election to Republican Kathy Love, 77.2 percent to 22.8 percent.
